name: New Mexico
stateTaxAgencyName: New Mexico Taxation and Revenue Department
dueDateNotes: New Mexico follows the federal schedule: April 15, June 15, September 15, and January 15.
selfEmploymentNotes: New Mexico restructured its rates for 2025 (HB 252) into six brackets from 1.5% to 5.9%. It conforms to the federal standard deduction and starts from your federal taxable income.
uniqueFacts: New Mexico restructured its income tax for 2025 (HB 252) into six brackets from 1.5% to 5.9%, cutting taxes for most middle-income filers.
New Mexico starts from your federal taxable income, so your federal standard deduction is already built into the calculation.
New Mexico's top 5.9% rate does not apply until $210,000 of taxable income (single) / $315,000 (joint).
